tierReasoning: Adds an authorization gate on an irreversible action (threadline_delete) plus the owner-approval primitive four sensitive handlers will cite. Auth + irreversibility raise the floor to Tier 2 even though it ships dark.

scope.summary: Owner-approved-sensitive-action primitive: a Face-ID-gated device-signed owner-presence approval (new purposes thread-delete/trust-grant) authorizes a sensitive action; isLocal is demoted from authority to signal. OwnerApprovedActionStore (single-use, TTL, revision-bound) + PendingApprovalRegistry (server-written card text) + four /mobile/action-approval routes (challenge/approve/pending/decline) reusing the existing owner-presence gate + verifyPresenceSignature; the threadline_delete MCP handler consumes an approval when enabled (dark default = byte-identical). Shared store/registry wired through server.ts into both the MCP gate and the phone routes.

evidence.incident: SEC-018: threadline_delete/_trust/_pair/_relay treated an isLocal (same-machine) call as the owner, but a local session can read the PIN and authToken off disk, so a peer-driven local session could irreversibly delete a conversation with no human action.
evidence.focusedTests: tests/unit/owner-approved-action-store.test.ts (7), tests/unit/pending-approval-registry.test.ts (6), tests/unit/mobile-owner-presence.test.ts action-approval byte contract (3), tests/e2e/owner-approved-sensitive-action-alive.test.ts (routes mounted + dark-safe)
evidence.signalVsAuthority: isLocal demoted to a signal; authority is a Face-ID-gated P256 owner-presence signature over a message binding {purpose, actionKey}, verified by the existing verifyPresenceSignature. Ships dark (security.ownerApprovedActions.enabled default false); dark path byte-identical.
